name: Grommet Flag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium windbreaker fabric, lightweight, durable, and designed for both indoor and outdoor display.
    - Features rustproof metal grommets for secure hanging and long-term use.
    - Reinforced with strong double-stitched seams to enhance durability and prevent fraying.
    - Weather-resistant material helps maintain vibrant colors over time.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
                +) 18 x 12 inches ~ 45.72 x 30.48 cm
                +) 36 x 24 inches ~ 91.44 x 60.96 cm
                +) 40 x 28 inches ~ 101.6 x 71.12 cm
                +) 60 x 36 inches ~ 152.4 x 91.44 cm
                +) 72 x 48 inches ~ 182.88 x 121.92 cm
                +) 96 x 60 inches ~ 243.84 x 152.4 cm
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–2 cm.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced dye-sublimation technology for vivid, high-resolution graphics.
    - Double-sided printing allows the design to be visible from both sides.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed for both indoor and outdoor display.
    - Easy to hang on walls, fences, poles, balconies, porches, garages, or event spaces.
    - Lightweight construction allows convenient installation, storage, and transportation.
    - Suitable for celebrations, gatherings, sporting events, patriotic displays, and home décor.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for family members, friends, veterans, patriots, or collectors.
    - Great for Independence Day, Memorial Day, Veterans Day, political events, birthdays, or special celebrations.
    - A meaningful decorative piece that showcases pride and personal style.
    - Ideal for enhancing outdoor spaces, party setups, or themed decorations. 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Grommet Flag

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
